decisions.reason: Operator training builds on existing service capabilities, likely meets its modest aspirations, and slack is sufficient to retain it.
Fourth rotary axis accessory leverages existing machinery know-how and likely performs close to aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from established offerings, its results likely fall below aspirations triggering problemistic search, and resources are better redeployed.
High-speed CNC milling machine line is close to the firm's core, represents strategic commitment, and is retained despite any short-term shortfalls.
Automatic tool change system complements existing machines, likely meets performance aspirations, and the firm keeps it.
